title: Runway Reach
commonMistakes: Exploring every jump instead of tracking the farthest reachable index
Returning too early when the current marker has a zero leap
Forgetting that a single-marker runway is already complete
Comparing the current index with the last index before verifying reachability
followUps: How would you return one sequence of landing positions that reaches the end?
What changes if backward leaps are allowed?
How would you count the number of distinct reachable landing positions?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
